Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the birth years. After correctly identifying that Eduardo Morera was born in 1906 and José Luis Garci was born in 1944, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Garci (born 1944) was born "earlier" than Morera (born 1906). The Planner also confused the comparison logic, stating "José Luis Garci is considered born earlier for this comparison" and then incorrectly claiming Garci is "older at release" to justify the conclusion, whereas the question asks who was born *earlier* in absolute time. 1906 is earlier than 1944, so the answer should be Idols Of The Radio, but the Planner concluded Solos En La Madrugada.
